0022600095.text: The Pacers, 1-0 and 2nd in the Central, host the Mavericks, who are 0-1 on the road and 11th in the West, in Indiana's second game of the season. Dallas beat Indiana 2-0 in the 2025-26 season series, and the most recent meeting was a 134-130 Pacers loss in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series. Indiana is without Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, while Aaron Nesmith and T.J. McConnell are day-to-day with hamstring issues and are game-time decisions, and Dallas is also listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision for Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel).
